summary: Apply a built-in or published template to an existing board (board manager): adds the template's columns on the left, moves every card into its first open column (closed cards stay closed), removes the old, now empty columns (removeOldColumns=false keeps them), adds missing labels, label groups and custom-field groups (never replaces), optionally the board settings and sample cards. dryRun previews; confirm=true applies. No automatic undo

fields.desc: remove the board's old columns once their cards have moved (default true: they are empty by then; their WIP/auto-close/auto-archive settings and column watches go with them). false keeps them, emptied, to the right

name: list.update
summary: Rename / recolour a list, set its description (brief for agents), soft WIP limit or auto-archive (archiveAfter: keep the newest N cards), switch whether it closes cards that land here (type closed|active), or change its position

fields.name: color
fields.desc: column colour: #rrggbb or a preset name; empty string clears the colour

fields.name: type
fields.desc: closed = close cards that land here (created in or moved to the column; moving them to an active column re-opens them), active = do not; see existingCards for the cards already in the column (list.typePreview counts them)

fields.name: description
fields.desc: brief for this column: what a card that lands here asks for; empty string clears it

fields.name: wipLimit
fields.desc: soft WIP limit (1-10000): the column header shows n/limit and flags it when over; advisory only, nothing is blocked; 0 removes the limit

fields.name: archiveAfter
fields.desc: auto-archive (1-10000): the column keeps at most this many cards; whenever more land here, the ones that have been in it longest (oldest list change first) go to the board's archive, where card.restore brings them back; cards with a live claim and, for now, cards with a recurrence rule are skipped (they still count); 0 turns it off. Setting or lowering it applies at once to the cards already here: when that would archive cards, confirmArchive=true is required (409 conflict with the count otherwise; list.archivePreview counts them)

fields.name: confirmArchive
fields.desc: with archiveAfter: confirm that the cards over the new limit are archived right now

fields.name: existingCards
fields.desc: when type changes: flip (default) = also close the open cards already in the column (switching to closed) or re-open its closed cards (switching to active); keep = leave them as they are, the setting applies only to cards that land from now on
